title: Todos a Bordo
summary: Sunday 2027-02-07. Adrian takes the whole Counter-Strike department, including the four unregistered Academy Green players, to Austin on his private jet. The CCT North America #1 groups and Group D schedule are shown: Kairos Gaming, Fluxo, Imperial and BetBoom, with Kairos x Fluxo as the first series on 2027-02-08. MOUZ beat G2 2-0 in IEM Dallas Group D. Players meet Stewie2K, now with Without a Roof, at the venue. Arthur remains stable in hospital.
keyEvents: 7:12 — Adrian decides to take all ten Counter-Strike players; Zayn remains the only registered reserve; the other four Academy players are accredited guests.
10:48 — Departure from the executive airport; the aircraft is Adrian's private jet; he says it is not the standard for Kairos travel.

12:04 — On the flight Luk shows the CCT draw: Group A BESTIA, Eternal Fire, The MongolZ, PARIVISION; Group B NRG, Wildcard, Envy, LAG; Group C Without a Roof, Ninjas in Pyjamas, HEROIC, 100 Thieves; Group D Kairos Gaming, Fluxo, Imperial, BetBoom. Two advance per group; all group series are MD3.
12:04 — Group D schedule: Round 1 Kairos x Fluxo and Imperial x BetBoom; Round 2 Kairos x Imperial and BetBoom x Fluxo; Round 3 Kairos x BetBoom and Fluxo x Imperial; exact times not set.
13:21 — IEM Dallas Group D round 2: MOUZ 2-0 G2 Esports (Dust II 13-2, Inferno 13-5).
14:06–17:06 — Landing in Austin, hotel, venue walk-through; Owen is nervous before his first official LAN.
18:12 — The Academy meet Stewie2K with Without a Roof (autimatic, Brehze, CeRq, FaNg); Kairos and Without a Roof are in different groups and could meet in the playoffs.
19:24 — Last meeting before the debut against Fluxo (exit, dav1deuS, zevy, kye, Ltz); the Train setups exposed on 2027-02-01 have been changed.
20:41 — Group dinner; Arthur joins by video, still hospitalised, stable and improving, with no definite discharge date.
23:16–23:49 — Caleb and Owen talk the night before; Kairos Gaming x Fluxo is the first official Counter-Strike series in the history of Kairos.
consequences: The Counter-Strike department is in Austin; the Kairos Gaming debut is the next morning.
canonIntroduced: The Counter-Strike department travels together to Austin on Adrian's private jet (2027-02-07).
